# Avnet ZedBoard board definition

Source: https://github.com/Avnet/bdf/tree/e9723b55a68b106fb4cdb645974d096cd3594a2a/zedboard/1.5

Avnet board definition 1.5 declares hardware revision D. XML files retain their Apache-2.0 copyright/license notices. Line endings are LF. The project license remains undecided; it does not replace these upstream terms. Vivado uses these files only to configure the ZedBoard PS/DDR/MIO preset. Physical board revision and DDR operation must still be verified on hardware.
